---
name: Work package
about: A piece of planned work, specified before it starts
title: "WP-<area>-<nn>: <title>"
labels: []
---

**Goal:** one sentence on the outcome.

**Interface:** the public function, route or component it adds or changes.

**Inputs and outputs:** types, with examples.

**Acceptance tests:** each one a runnable check.

**Ledger:** entries this work writes, if any.

**Files:** the folders it adds to or creates (see `docs/architecture/repository.md`).

**Docs:** the pages it updates or creates, and its work-log entry.

**Neutrality:** confirm no sector terms in core code.

**Out of scope:** what it must not touch.

**Depends on:** WP ids.

**Reviewer:** R1–R4.
